messages:
lucy-customer: Hi team, invoice INV-2026-1357 just charged us with 8.875% US sales tax even though we're an EU B2B with a valid VAT ID on file. Can you check?

maria-support: Sorry about that Lucy. Can you paste the invoice link and confirm the VAT ID on your account? Also which payment method did you use?

lucy-customer: Invoice: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-1357. VAT ID: GB999888777. Payment was a corporate card (Visa) from our finance team. Screenshot attached.

maria-support: Thanks. Escalating to finance for tax calculation audit. @devin-finance can you pull the calc log for INV-2026-1357?

billing-bot: Audit task created: AUD-8241 assigned to devin-finance.

devin-finance: Looking now. Quick note: our tax service logs a resolution path. Pasting the decision snippet for that invoice:

```
invoice_id=INV-2026-1357
customer_id=CUST-4421
billing_profile.country=GB
customer.vat_id=GB999888777 (verified)
payment_method.bin_country=US
resolved_tax_jurisdiction = payment_method.bin_country  # <-- unexpected
applied_tax = US_SALES_TAX 8.875%
```

It looks like payment_method.bin_country took precedence over the customer's billing_profile and verified VAT.

maria-support: That smells like fallback order change. Was there a recent change to tax resolution?

sam-engineer: I rolled the tax resolution refactor in 2026-03-05 (deploy 2026-03-05T03:12Z). The intended precedence should be: billing_profile.country -> customer.country -> payment_method.bin_country. I see in the refactor the order got flipped by accident. :grimacing:

devin-finance: Repro steps for the bug locally: create customer with billing_profile.country=GB and verified VAT, charge a US BIN card -> tax_service picks BIN country.

sam-engineer: Patch ready, will swap precedence back and add explicit test cases (billing_profile wins when VAT present). Will push hotfix to staging now, then prod. Estimated rollout 30m.

maria-support: For the customer: we should issue a credit and reissue corrected invoice with 0% VAT since it's a B2B EU VAT reverse charge. Devin, can you prepare the credit note?

devin-finance: Creating credit note and refund flow. Credit created: CR-4567 referencing INV-2026-1357. Refund pending to payment_method masked ****4242, amount: tax portion $43.22.

billing-bot: Credit CR-4567 created and queued for payout.

maria-support: Lucy — we'll reverse the tax charge, issue CR-4567, and reissue a corrected invoice. Hotfix is going out in ~30m; finance will process the refund once patch is live. Apologies for the disruption.

lucy-customer: Thanks, appreciate the fast follow-up. Rough ETA for when the refund shows on the card?

devin-finance: Once the credit posts (expect within 2 business days), card networks push refunds to the issuer. We'll email you the refund trace and new invoice ID when done.

sam-engineer: Hotfix deployed to prod and health checks green. Added unit and integration tests to prevent regression. Patch: commit 7f9d2ab -> tax-resolution: enforce billing_profile.country precedence.

maria-support: Verified updated tax logic on a repro invoice in prod sandbox. Billing team confirmed credit CR-4567 posted to payout queue. :white_check_mark:

lucy-customer: Confirmed refund hit our bank (appeared as a chargeback reversal). New invoice looks good with 0% VAT. Thank you all! :pray:

maria-support: Closing the loop here. Ticket -> support-12841. If anything else pops up ping me directly.
